people.descriptor: Founder and Grand Progenitor of Northern Zhou
Consort and mother of Emperor Ming
Grand Tutor and Duke of Zhao
Duke of Lu; later Emperor Wu of Zhou
Queen and Empress Jing of Emperor Ming
Duke of Liang and high minister
Junior Tutor and Duke of Han
Grand Marshal and Duke of Liang
Legendary calendar maker under Yellow Emperor
Legendary calendar officer of Tang Yao
Duke of Chu and high minister
Han emperor quoted on imperial treasury
Father of Chen Qian; elder brother of Chen Baxian
Duke of Qiao; imperial younger brother
Duke of Chen; imperial younger brother
Duke of Yue; imperial younger brother
Duke of Dai; imperial younger brother
Duke of Ji; imperial younger brother
Duke of Teng; imperial younger brother
Son and successor of Emperor Wenxuan of Qi

units.zh: 世宗明皇帝諱毓，小名統萬突，太祖長子也。
units.en: Emperor Ming, canonically titled Shizong, bore the taboo name Yu and in childhood was called Tongwantu; he was the eldest son of Yuwen Tai.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong Ming, taboo name Yu, childhood name Tongwantu, was the eldest son of the Grand Progenitor.

units.zh: 母曰姚夫人，永熙三年，太祖臨夏州，生帝於統萬城，因以名焉。
units.en: His mother was Lady Yao. In the third year of Yongxi (534), while Yuwen Tai was in Xia Province, the future emperor was born at Tongwan and took his childhood name from the city.
units.literal: His mother was Lady Yao; in the third year of Yongxi, when the Grand Progenitor was stationed at Xia Province, the Emperor was born at Tongwan city, whence he received his name.

units.zh: 大統十四年，封寧都郡公。
units.en: In the fourteenth year of Datong (548) he was enfeoffed as duke of Ningdu commandery.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year of Datong, he was enfeoffed as Duke of Ningdu commandery.

units.zh: 十六年，行華州事。
units.en: In the sixteenth year (550) he acted as administrator of Hua Province.
units.literal: In the sixteenth year, he administered Hua Province affairs.

units.zh: 尋拜開府儀同三司、宜州諸軍事、宜州刺史。
units.en: He was soon made commissioner with Three Excellencies protocol, commander of all Yi Province forces, and governor of Yi Province.
units.literal: Soon after he was appointed commissioner with protocol equal to the Three Excellencies, commander of all military affairs in Yi Province, and governor of Yi Province.

units.zh: 魏恭帝三年，授大將軍，鎮隴右。
units.en: In the third year of Western Wei Emperor Gong (556) he was made grand general and posted to Longyou.
units.literal: In the third year of Emperor Gong of Wei, he was granted the post of grand general and garrisoned Longyou.

units.zh: 孝閔帝踐阼，進位柱國，轉岐州諸軍事、岐州刺史。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaomin took the throne he was promoted to pillar-of-state and transferred to command of Qi Province forces and the governorship of Qi Province.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin acceded, he was advanced to pillar-of-state and transferred to commander of all military affairs in Qi Province and governor of Qi Province.

units.zh: 治有美政，黎民懷之。
units.en: His rule won praise; the people held him in affection.
units.literal: His governance had fine policies; the common people cherished him.

units.zh: 及孝閔帝廢，晉公護遣使迎帝於岐州。
units.en: After Emperor Xiaomin was deposed, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu sent envoys to bring the future emperor from Qi Province.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaomin was deposed, the Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu sent envoys to welcome the Emperor from Qi Province.

units.zh: 秋九月癸亥，至京師，止於舊邸。
units.en: In the ninth month of autumn, on guihai day, he reached the capital and stayed at his old residence.
units.literal: In autumn, ninth month, day guihai, he reached the capital and lodged at his former residence.

units.zh: 甲子，羣臣上表勸進，備法駕奉迎。
units.en: On jiazi day the ministers memorialized urging him to ascend the throne and came with the full imperial escort to receive him.
units.literal: On jiazi day the ministers submitted memorials urging his accession, fully equipped with the imperial carriage to escort him.

units.zh: 帝固讓，羣臣固請，是日，即天王位，大赦天下。
units.en: He refused firmly; the court pressed him again; that day he accepted the throne as heavenly king and proclaimed a general amnesty.
units.literal: The Emperor firmly declined; the ministers firmly urged him; on that day he took the throne as Heavenly King and proclaimed a general amnesty.

units.zh: 乙丑，朝羣臣於延壽殿。
units.en: On yichou day he held audience with his ministers in the Hall of Extended Life.
units.literal: On yichou day he held court with the ministers in the Hall of Extended Life.

units.zh: 冬十月癸酉，太師、趙國公李弼薨。
units.en: In winter, on guiyou in the tenth month, Grand Tutor Li Bi, Duke of Zhao, died.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on guiyou day Grand Tutor Li Bi, Duke of Zhao, died.

units.zh: 己卯，以大將軍、昌平公尉遲綱為柱國。
units.en: On jimao day Grand General Yuchi Gang, Duke of Changping, was made pillar of state.
units.literal: On jimao day Grand General Yuchi Gang, Duke of Changping, was made pillar of state.

units.zh: 乙酉，祠圓丘。
units.en: On yiyou day he sacrificed at the Circular Mound.
units.literal: On yiyou day sacrifice was offered at the Circular Mound.

units.zh: 丙戌，祠方丘。
units.en: On bingxu day he sacrificed at the Square Mound.
units.literal: On bingxu day sacrifice was offered at the Square Mound.

units.zh: 甲午，祠太社。
units.en: On jiawu day he sacrificed at the Great Altar of Soil.
units.literal: On jiawu day sacrifice was offered at the Great Altar of Soil.

units.zh: 柱國、陽平公李遠賜死。
units.en: Pillar-of-State Li Yuan, Duke of Yangping, was ordered to take his own life.
units.literal: Pillar-of-State Li Yuan, Duke of Yangping, was granted death.

units.zh: 是月，梁相陳霸先廢其主蕭方智而自立，是為陳武帝。
units.en: That month Liang chancellor Chen Baxian deposed his ruler Xiao Fangzhi and took the throne himself as Chen Wudi.
units.literal: That month Liang Chancellor Chen Baxian deposed his ruler Xiao Fangzhi and established himself—this was Chen Wudi.

units.zh: 十一月庚子，祠太廟。
units.en: In the eleventh month, on gengzi day, he offered sacrifice at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, day gengzi, he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestors' Temple.

units.zh: 丁未，祠圓丘。
units.en: On dingwei day he sacrificed at the Circular Mound.
units.literal: On dingwei day he sacrificed at the Circular Mound.

units.zh: 丁巳，詔曰：「帝王之道，以寬仁為大。
units.en: On dingsi day an edict declared: "The way of kings and emperors rests above all on clemency and benevolence.
units.literal: On dingsi day an edict said: "The way of emperors and kings takes lenity and benevolence as supreme.

units.zh: 魏政諸有輕犯未至重罪、及諸村民一家有犯乃及數家而被遠配者，並宜放還。」
units.en: Under Wei law, all who had committed minor offenses not amounting to grave crime, and all villages where one family's guilt had sent several households into distant exile, should be released and sent home."
units.literal: Under Wei rule, all those who had committed light offenses short of serious crime, and villages where one household's offense had drawn exile upon several families, should all be released and returned."

units.zh: 十二月庚午，謁成陵。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on gengwu day, he visited Chengling Mausoleum.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, day gengwu, he visited Chengl Mausoleum.

units.zh: 癸酉，還宮。
units.en: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.
units.literal: On guiyou day he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 庚辰，以大將軍、輔城公邕為柱國。
units.en: On gengchen day he made Grand General Yuwen Yong, Duke of Fucheng, a pillar-of-state.
units.literal: On gengchen day he made the grand general, Duke of Fucheng Yong, a pillar-of-state.

units.zh: 戊子，赦長安見囚。
units.en: On wuzi day he pardoned prisoners then held in Chang'an.
units.literal: On wuzi day he pardoned prisoners held in Chang'an.

units.zh: 甲午，詔曰：「善人之後，猶累世獲宥，況魏氏以德讓代終，豈容不加隱恤。
units.en: On jiawu day an edict said: "The descendants of the virtuous still win pardon generation after generation; how much more when the Wei dynasty yielded the throne in virtue—can we withhold compassion?
units.literal: On jiawu day an edict said: "The descendants of good men still receive pardon generation after generation; how much more when the Wei house ended by yielding the throne in virtue—can we fail to show hidden care and pity?

units.zh: 元氏子女自坐趙貴等事以來，所有沒入為官口者，悉宜放免。」
units.en: Since the Yuan imperial clan was implicated in the Zhao Gui affair and after, all sons and daughters confiscated as government bond-slaves should be released and freed."
units.literal: Since the Yuan clan sons and daughters were implicated in the Zhao Gui affair and afterward, all who had been confiscated as government bond-slaves should be released and freed."

units.zh: 二年春正月乙未，以大冢宰、晉公護為太師。
units.en: In spring of the second year, first month, on yiwei day, Grand Preceptor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was made grand tutor.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, first month, day yiwei, the Grand Preceptor, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was made Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 辛亥，親耕籍田。
units.en: On xinhai day he performed the ceremonial plowing at the sacred field.
units.literal: On xinhai day he personally plowed the sacred field.

units.zh: 癸丑，立王后獨孤氏。
units.en: On guichou day he installed Lady Dugu as queen.
units.literal: On guichou day he established Lady Dugu as queen.

units.zh: 丁巳，雍州置十二郡。
units.en: On dingsi day twelve commanderies were set up within Yong Province.
units.literal: On dingsi day twelve commanderies were established in Yong Province.

units.zh: 又於河東置蒲州，河北置虞州，弘農置陝州，正平置絳州，宜陽置熊州，邵郡置邵州。
units.en: Pu Province was also established in Hedong, Yu Province in Hebei, Shan Province in Hongnong, Jiang Province in Zhengping, Xiong Province in Yiyang, and Shao Province in Shao commandery.
units.literal: Also in Hedong Pu Province was established, in Hebei Yu Province, in Hongnong Shan Province, in Zhengping Jiang Province, in Yiyang Xiong Province, and in Shao commandery Shao Province.

units.zh: 二月癸未，詔曰：「王者之宰民也，莫不同四海，一遠近，為父母而子之。
units.en: Second month, on guiwei day, an edict said: "In governing the people, a king must make the four seas one and near and far alike, acting as a parent to his children.
units.literal: Second month, day guiwei, an edict said: "When kings rule the people, none fail to treat all within the four seas alike, making near and far one, acting as parents and treating them as children.

units.zh: 一物失所，若納于隍。
units.en: If one thing is out of place, it is as into a gutter.
units.literal: If one thing loses its proper place, it is as into a gutter.

units.zh: 賊之境土，本同大化，往因時難，致阻東西。
units.en: Rebel-held lands once shared the same civilizing rule; wartime hardship had cut east from west.
units.literal: The rebel territories originally shared the same great transformation; in the past because of the difficulties of the times they came to be blocked east and west.

units.zh: 遂使疆埸之間，互相抄掠。
units.en: Border districts therefore raided and plundered one another.
units.literal: Thus at the borders they raided and plundered one another.

units.zh: 興言及此，良可哀傷。
units.en: To speak of it is truly heartbreaking.
units.literal: To speak of this is truly cause for grief.

units.zh: 自元年以來，有被掠入賊者，悉可放免。」
units.en: Since the first year of the reign, all who were seized and carried into enemy territory may be released and sent home."
units.literal: Since the first year, all who were captured and taken into rebel territory may be released and freed."

units.zh: 自冬不雨，至於是月方大雪。
units.en: Rain had failed since winter; only in this month did heavy snow come.
units.literal: From winter there had been no rain; only in this month did heavy snow fall.

units.zh: 三月甲午，齊北豫州刺史司馬消難舉州來附，遣柱國、高陽公達奚武與大將軍楊忠率衆迎之。
units.en: Third month, on jiawu day, Northern Qi's governor of North Yu Province, Sima Xiaonan, surrendered the province; the court sent Pillar-of-State Daxi Wu, Duke of Gaoyang, and Grand General Yang Zhong with troops to receive him.
units.literal: Third month, day jiawu, Northern Qi's governor of North Yu Province Sima Xiaonan raised the province in submission; he dispatched Pillar-of-State, Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu and Grand General Yang Zhong to lead troops to welcome him.

units.zh: 改雍州刺史為雍州牧，京兆郡守為京兆尹。
units.en: The Yong Province governor was retitled governor-general of Yong Province, and the Jingzhao commandery prefect became intendant of Jingzhao.
units.literal: The governor of Yong Province was changed to governor-general of Yong Province, and the prefect of Jingzhao commandery to intendant of Jingzhao.

units.zh: 以廣業、脩城二郡置康州，葭蘆郡置文州。
units.en: Guangye and Xiucheng commanderies were combined into Kang Province, and Jialu commandery into Wen Province.
units.literal: The two commanderies of Guangye and Xiucheng were made into Kang Province, and Jialu commandery into Wen Province.

units.zh: 戊申，長安獻白雀。
units.en: On wushen day Chang'an presented a white sparrow.
units.literal: On wushen day a white sparrow was presented from Chang'an.

units.zh: 庚申，詔曰：「三十六國，九十九姓，自魏氏南徙，皆稱河南之民。
units.en: On gengshen day an edict said: "The thirty-six states and ninety-nine surnames, since the Wei dynasty moved south, were all called people of Henan.
units.literal: On gengshen day an edict said: "The thirty-six states and ninety-nine surnames, since the Wei house moved south, all were called the people of Henan.

units.zh: 今周室旣都關中，宜改稱京兆人。」
units.en: Now that Zhou holds the capital in Guanzhong, they should be called people of Jingzhao."
units.literal: Now that the Zhou house has its capital in Guanzhong, they should be renamed people of Jingzhao."

units.zh: 夏四月己巳，以太師、晉公護為雍州牧。
units.en: In summer, fourth month, on jisi day, Grand Tutor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was made governor-general of Yong Province.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, day jisi, the Grand Tutor, Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu was made governor-general of Yong Province.

units.zh: 庚午，熒惑入軒轅。
units.en: On gengwu day Mars entered the Xuanyuan asterism.
units.literal: On gengwu day Mars entered the Xuanyuan constellation.

units.zh: 辛未，降死罪一等，五歲刑已下皆原之。
units.en: On xinwei day death sentences were commuted one grade, and punishments of five years or less were all forgiven.
units.literal: On xinwei day capital crimes were reduced one grade; punishments of five years or less were all remitted.

units.zh: 甲戌，王后獨孤氏崩。
units.en: On jiaxu day Queen Lady Dugu died.
units.literal: On jiaxu day Queen Lady Dugu died.

units.zh: 甲申，葬敬后。
units.en: On jiashen day Empress Jing was buried.
units.literal: On jiashen day Empress Jing was buried.

units.zh: 五月乙未，以大司空、梁國公侯莫陳崇為大宗伯。
units.en: Fifth month, on yiwei day, Grand Minister of Works Houmochen Chong, Duke of Liang, was made grand director of ceremonies.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day yiwei, the Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Yuwen Houmochen Chong was made Grand Director of Ceremonies.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，獻噠遣使獻方物。
units.en: Sixth month, on guihai day, the Hephthalites (Yeda) sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In the sixth month, day guihai, Yeda sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

units.zh: 己巳，板授高年刺史、守、令，恤鰥寡孤獨各有差。
units.en: On jisi day elderly men were honored with plaque appointments as governors, prefects, and magistrates; widowers, widows, orphans, and the alone received graded relief.
units.literal: On jisi day elderly men were appointed by plaque as governors, prefects, and magistrates; widowers, widows, orphans, and the solitary were given relief each according to rank.

units.zh: 分長安為萬年縣，並治京城。
units.en: Chang'an was split into Wannian county; the two counties jointly administered the capital.
units.literal: Chang'an was divided into Wannian county; both jointly administered the capital.

units.zh: 辛未，幸昆明池。
units.en: On xinwei day he visited Kunming Pool.
units.literal: On xinwei day he visited Kunming Pool.

units.zh: 壬申，長安獻白烏。
units.en: On renshen day Chang'an presented a white crow.
units.literal: On renshen day a white crow was presented from Chang'an.

units.zh: 遣使分行州郡，理囚徒，察風俗，掩骼埋胔。
units.en: Envoys were sent through the provinces and commanderies to review prisoners, inspect local custom, and gather bones and bury the unburied dead.
units.literal: Envoys were dispatched separately through the provinces and commanderies to settle prisoners, inspect local custom, and gather bones and bury the unburied dead.

units.zh: 秋七月甲午，遣柱國、甯蜀公尉遲迥率衆於河南築安樂城。
units.en: Seventh month of autumn, on jiawu day, he sent Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Ningshu, with troops to build Anle fortress in Henan.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, day jiawu, he dispatched Pillar-of-State, Duke of Ningshu Yuchi Jiong to lead troops to build Anle fortress in Henan.

units.zh: 丙申，順陽獻三足烏。
units.en: On bingshen day Shunyang presented a three-legged crow.
units.literal: On bingshen day Shunyang presented a three-legged crow.

units.zh: 八月甲子，羣臣上表稱慶。
units.en: Eighth month, on jiazi day, the ministers submitted memorials of congratulation.
units.literal: In the eighth month, day jiazi, the ministers submitted memorials of congratulation.

units.zh: 詔曰：「夫天不愛寶，地稱表瑞，莫不威鳳巢閣，圖龍躍沼，豈直日月珠連，風雨玉燭。
units.en: An edict said: "Heaven does not hoard its treasures; earth displays auspicious signs—the awe-inspiring phoenix nests in the tower, the patterned dragon leaps in the pool; how much more than sun and moon strung like pearls, wind and rain like jade candles?
units.literal: An edict said: "Heaven does not hoard treasures; earth is said to display auspicious signs—all witness the phoenix nesting in the tower, the dragon leaping in the pool; how much more than sun and moon strung like pearls, wind and rain like jade candles?

units.zh: 是以《鈎命決》曰『王者至孝則出』，元命苞曰『人君至治所有』。
units.en: Thus Hooks Life Verdict says, "When the king is supremely filial, it appears," and Primordial Mandate Bud says, "When the ruler's governance is supreme, he possesses it."
units.literal: Thus Hooks Life Verdict says 'When the king is supremely filial it appears,' and Primordial Mandate Bud says 'When the ruler's governance is supreme it is possessed.'

units.zh: 虞舜烝烝，來茲異趾；
units.en: Yu Shun, utterly filial, here received the strange foot;
units.literal: Yu Shun in utmost filial piety, here came the strange foot;

units.zh: 周文翼翼，翔此靈禽。
units.en: King Wen of Zhou, reverent and careful, here saw this numinous bird soar.
units.literal: Zhou Wen diligent and reverent, this numinous bird soared here.

units.zh: 文考至德下覃，遺仁爰被，遠符千載，降斯三足。
units.en: King Wen's utmost virtue spread below; his surviving benevolence still reaches abroad; a thousand years matched, this three-footed bird was sent down.
units.literal: Our late father of utmost virtue spread below, his remaining benevolence therein extended, matching a thousand years afar, sent down this three-footed bird.

units.zh: 將使三方歸本，九州翕定。
units.en: It will bring the three regions back to their root and settle the nine provinces in harmony.
units.literal: It will cause the three directions to return to the root and the nine provinces to be harmoniously settled.

units.zh: 惟此大體，景福在民。
units.en: In this great cause, bright fortune rests with the people.
units.literal: In this great matter alone, bright fortune rests on the people.

units.zh: 予安敢讓宗廟之善，弗宣大惠。
units.en: How dare I withhold the ancestral temple's blessing and fail to proclaim a great grace?
units.literal: How dare I decline the goodness of the ancestral temple and fail to proclaim a great grace?

units.zh: 可大赦天下，文武官普進二級。」
units.en: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm, and let civil and military officials all advance two ranks."
units.literal: A general amnesty may be proclaimed for the empire; civil and military officials may all advance two ranks."

units.zh: 九月辛卯，以大將軍楊忠、大將軍王雄並為柱國。
units.en: Ninth month, on xinmao day, Grand Generals Yang Zhong and Wang Xiong were both made pillars-of-state.
units.literal: In the ninth month, day xinmao, Grand Generals Yang Zhong and Wang Xiong were both made pillars-of-state.

units.zh: 甲辰，封少師元羅為韓國公，以紹魏後。
units.en: On jiachen day Junior Tutor Yuan Luo was enfeoffed as Duke of Han to continue the Wei line.
units.literal: On jiachen day Junior Tutor Yuan Luo was enfeoffed as Duke of Han and appointed to continue the Wei line.

units.zh: 丁未，幸同州。
units.en: On dingwei day he visited Tong Province.
units.literal: On dingwei day he visited Tong Province.

units.zh: 過故宅，賦詩曰：「玉燭調秋氣，金輿曆舊宮。
units.en: Passing his old home, he composed a poem: "Jade candles tune the autumn air; the gold carriage passes the old palace.
units.literal: Passing his former residence, he composed a poem: "Jade candles adjust the autumn air, the gold carriage traverses the old palace.

units.zh: 還如過白水，更似入新豐。
units.en: Turning back is like crossing Baishui again; it feels even more like entering Xinfeng.
units.literal: Returning as if crossing Baishui again, more like entering Xinfeng.

units.zh: 霜潭漬晚菊，寒井落疏桐。
units.en: Frosted pools steep the late chrysanthemums; a cold well sheds sparse paulownia leaves.
units.literal: Frost pools soak the late chrysanthemums; the cold well drops sparse paulownia.

units.zh: 舉杯延故老，令聞歌《大風》。」
units.en: Raising his cup to old friends present, he had them sing Great Wind."
units.literal: Raising the cup to invite old friends, he ordered them to hear the singing of Great Wind."

units.zh: 冬十月辛酉，還宮。
units.en: Tenth month of winter, on xinyou day, he returned to the palace.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, day xinyou, he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 乙丑，遣柱國尉遲迥鎮隴右。
units.en: On yichou day he sent Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong to garrison Longyou.
units.literal: On yichou day he dispatched Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong to garrison Longyou.

units.zh: 長安獻白兔。
units.en: Chang'an presented a white hare.
units.literal: A white hare was presented from Chang'an.

units.zh: 十二月辛酉，突厥遣使獻方物。
units.en: Twelfth month, on xinyou day, the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, day xinyou, the Turks sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

units.zh: 癸亥，太廟成。
units.en: On guihai day the Imperial Ancestors' Temple was completed.
units.literal: On guihai day the Imperial Ancestors' Temple was completed.

units.zh: 辛巳，以功臣琅邪貞獻公賀拔勝等十三人配享太祖廟庭。
units.en: On xinsi day thirteen meritorious ministers, including Helba Sheng, Duke of Langye Zhenxian, were granted paired sacrifice in Yuwen Tai's temple court.
units.literal: On xinsi day thirteen meritorious ministers including Helba Sheng, Duke of Langye Zhenxian, and others were given paired sacrifice in the Grand Progenitor's temple court.

units.zh: 壬午，大赦天下。
units.en: On renwu day a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
units.literal: On renywu day a general amnesty was proclaimed for the empire.

units.zh: 武成元年春正月己酉，太師、晉公護上表歸政，帝始親覽萬機。
units.en: In spring of Wucheng year one, on jiyou of the first month, Grand Tutor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu submitted a memorial returning government, and the emperor began personally overseeing state affairs.
units.literal: In spring of the first year of Wucheng, on jiyou of the first month, Grand Tutor Duke of Jin Yuwen Hu submitted a memorial returning government; the emperor began personally handling the myriad affairs of state.

units.zh: 軍旅之事，護猶總焉。
units.en: Military affairs remained under Hu's overall command.
units.literal: As for military affairs, Hu still held overall command.

units.zh: 初改都督諸州軍事為總管。
units.en: For the first time the title of commander of military affairs of the various provinces was changed to governor-general.
units.literal: For the first time the title of commander of military affairs of the various provinces was changed to governor-general.

units.zh: 丙辰，封大將軍、章武孝公導子亮為永昌公，翼為西陽公。
units.en: On bingchen day Grand General Zhangwu Xiaogong Dao's son Liang was enfeoffed Duke of Yongchang, and Yi was made Duke of Xiyang.
units.literal: On bingchen day Grand General Zhangwu Xiaogong Dao's son Liang was enfeoffed Duke of Yongchang, and Yi was made Duke of Xiyang.

units.zh: 三月癸巳，陳六軍，帝親擐甲冑，迎太白於東方。
units.en: Third month, on guisi day, the six armies were drawn up; the emperor personally donned armor and helmet and welcomed Venus in the east.
units.literal: Third month, day guisi, the six armies were arrayed; the Emperor personally donned armor and helmet and welcomed the White Planet in the east.

units.zh: 秦郡公直鎮蒲州。
units.en: Yuwen Zhi, Duke of Qin commandery, garrisoned Pu Province.
units.literal: Duke of Qin commandery Zhi garrisoned Pu Province.

units.zh: 吐谷渾寇邊，庚戌，遣大司馬、博陵公賀蘭祥率衆討之。
units.en: Tuyuhun raided the frontier; on gengxu day he sent Grand Marshal Helan Xiang, Duke of Boling, with troops to punish them.
units.literal: Tuyuhun raided the border; on gengxu day he dispatched Grand Marshal, Duke of Boling Helan Xiang to lead troops to suppress them.

units.zh: 四月戊午，武當郡獻赤烏。
units.en: Fourth month, on wuwu day, Wudang commandery presented a red crow.
units.literal: In the fourth month, day wuwu, Wudang commandery presented a red crow.

units.zh: 甲戌，雲。
units.en: On jiaxu day auspicious clouds appeared.
units.literal: On jiaxu day, clouds.

units.zh: 秦州獻白馬朱鬣。
units.en: Qin Province presented a white horse with a red mane.
units.literal: Qin Province presented a white horse with red mane.

units.zh: 五月戊子，詔曰：「皇王之迹不一，因革之道已殊，莫不播八政以成物，兆三元而為紀。
units.en: Fifth month, on wuzi day, an edict said: "The ways of emperors and kings are not one; paths of reform already differ; all spread the eight governances to complete creation and take the three origins as their measure.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day wuzi, an edict said: "The traces of emperors and kings are not one; the paths of change and reform already differ; none fail to spread the eight governances to complete things and take the three origins as their standard.

units.zh: 是以容成創定於軒轅，羲和欽若於唐世，《鴻範》九疇，大弘五法。
units.en: Thus Rongcheng first fixed the calendar under the Yellow Emperor, and Xihe reverently kept time in the age of Tang; the nine categories of Great Plan greatly extended the five methods.
units.literal: Thus Rongcheng first established at Xuanyuan, Xihe reverently observed in the Tang age; the nine categories of Great Plan greatly extended the five methods.

units.zh: 《易》曰：「澤中有火，革，君子以治曆明時。」
units.en: The Changes says: "Fire in the marsh—innovation; the gentleman uses it to regulate the calendar and clarify the seasons."
units.literal: The Changes says: 'Fire in the marsh—innovation; the gentleman uses it to regulate the calendar and clarify the seasons.'

units.zh: 故歷之為義大矣。
units.en: Thus the meaning of the calendar is indeed great.
units.literal: Thus the meaning of the calendar is great indeed.

units.zh: 但忽微成象，象極則差；
units.en: Yet subtle signs become phenomena, and when phenomena reach their limit error follows;
units.literal: But subtle signs become phenomena; when phenomena reach their limit there is error;

units.zh: 分積命時，時積斯舛。
units.en: Fractions accumulate to fix the seasons; as seasons accumulate, discrepancies arise.
units.literal: Fractions accumulate to determine time; when time accumulates, then come discrepancies.

units.zh: 開闢至於獲麟，二百七十六萬歲，晷度推移，餘分盈縮，南正無聞，疇人靡記。
units.en: From the world's opening to the Capture of the Unicorn, 2,760,000 years—the gnomon and degrees shifted, remainders waxed and waned, the south-first month went unmarked, and calendar officers left no record.
units.literal: From the opening of the world until the Capture of the Unicorn, 2,760,000 years—the gnomon and degrees shifted, fractional remainders waxed and waned, the south-first month was unheard of, calendar specialists had no record.

units.zh: 暑往寒來，理乖攸序，敬授民時，何其積謬。
units.en: Summer passes and winter comes—the order is wrong; to reverently grant seasons to the people—how piled the errors!
units.literal: Summer gone, winter come—the principle deviates from proper order; reverently bestowing seasons on the people—how accumulated the errors!

units.zh: 昔漢世巴郡洛下閎善治歷，云後八百歲，當有聖人定之。
units.en: In Han times Luoxia Hong of Ba commandery was skilled at calendrics; he said that eight hundred years later a sage would fix the calendar.
units.literal: Formerly in Han times Luoxia Hong of Ba commandery was skilled at regulating the calendar; he said that eight hundred years later a sage would fix it.

units.zh: 自火行至今，木德應其運矣，朕何讓焉。
units.en: From the Fire phase until now the Wood virtue answers its turn; why should I decline?
units.literal: From the Fire phase until now, the Wood virtue answers its turn; why should I decline?

units.zh: 可命有司，傍稽六曆，仰觀七曜，博推古今，造我周曆，量定以聞。」
units.en: Let the responsible offices consult the six calendars, observe the seven luminaries, compare past and present broadly, create the Zhou calendar, measure and fix it, and report."
units.literal: Let the relevant offices be ordered to consult the six calendars at hand, look up to the seven luminaries, broadly compare past and present, create our Zhou calendar, measure and fix it, and report."

units.zh: 己亥，聽訟於正武殿。
units.en: On jihai day he heard lawsuits at the Hall of Righteous Martialness.
units.literal: On jihai day he heard cases at the Hall of Righteous Martialness.

units.zh: 辛亥，以大宗伯、梁國公侯莫陳崇為大司徒，大司寇、高陽公達奚武為大宗伯，武陽公豆盧甯為大司寇，柱國、輔城公邕為大司空。
units.en: On xinhai day Grand Director of Ceremonies Houmochen Chong, Duke of Liang, was made grand minister of education; Grand Minister of Justice Daxi Wu, Duke of Gaoyang, was made grand director of ceremonies; Doulu Ning, Duke of Wuyang, was made grand minister of justice; and Pillar-of-State Yuwen Yong, Duke of Fucheng, was made grand minister of works.
units.literal: On xinhai day the Grand Director of Ceremonies, Duke of Liang Yuwen Houmochen Chong was made Grand Minister of Education; Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu was made Grand Director of Ceremonies; Duke of Wuyang Doulu Ning was made Grand Minister of Justice; Pillar-of-State, Duke of Fucheng Yu was made Grand Minister of Works.

units.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「比屢有糾發官司赦前事。
units.en: On yimao day an edict said: "Lately offices have repeatedly been impeached for offenses committed before the amnesty.
units.literal: On yimao day an edict said: "Recently offices have repeatedly been impeached for pre-amnesty matters.

units.zh: 此雖意在疾惡，但先王制肆眚之道，令天下自新，若又推問，自新何由哉。
units.en: That may aim at hating evil, but former kings instituted amnesty so the realm could renew itself; if cases are pursued again, how can anyone begin anew?
units.literal: This though intended to abhor evil, yet the former kings established the way of granting amnesty to let the empire renew itself; if one again investigates, how can renewal be achieved?

units.zh: 如此之徒，有司勿為推究。
units.en: Officials are not to pursue cases of this kind.
units.literal: Persons such as these—the relevant offices should not investigate them.

units.zh: 惟庫廄倉廩與海內所共，漢帝有云『朕為天下守財耳』。
units.en: The imperial stores and granaries belong to the realm as a whole. A Han emperor put it plainly: "I am only the empire's treasurer."
units.literal: Only the treasury stables, granaries, and storehouses are held in common with all within the seas. A Han emperor once said, "I merely keep treasure for the empire."

units.zh: 若有侵盜公家財畜錢粟者，魏朝之事，年月旣遠，一不須問。
units.en: Theft of public property dating to Wei times is too remote to investigate.
units.literal: Should anyone have plundered public livestock, money, or grain, as for Wei-dynasty matters long past, there is no need to inquire at all.

units.zh: 自周有天下以來，雖經赦宥，而事蹟可知者，有司宜即推窮。
units.en: Since our dynasty began, even when pardon has covered a crime, officials must still investigate any case whose facts remain clear.
units.literal: Since Zhou gained the realm, even if amnesty was granted, wherever the facts can still be established, the relevant offices should at once pursue the case to the end.

units.zh: 得實之日，但免其罪，徵備如法。」
units.en: Once guilt is proved, the offender is spared punishment but must make full restitution by law."
units.literal: When guilt is established, only the punishment is remitted; restitution is exacted according to law."

units.zh: 賀蘭祥攻拔洮陽、洪和二城，吐谷渾遁走。
units.en: Helan Xiang took Taoyang and Honghe, and the Tuyuhun withdrew.
units.literal: Helan Xiang attacked and captured the cities of Taoyang and Honghe; the Tuyuhun fled.

units.zh: 閏月庚申，高昌遣使獻方物。
units.en: In the intercalary month, on gengshen day, Gaochang sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, day gengshen, Gaochang sent envoys presenting tribute goods.

units.zh: 六月戊子，大雨霖。
units.en: In the sixth month, on wuzi day, torrential rains set in.
units.literal: In the sixth month, day wuzi, great rains fell in succession.

units.zh: 詔曰：「昔唐咨四嶽，殷告六眚，睹災興懼，咸寘時雍。
units.en: An edict read: "In antiquity Yao questioned the Four Peaks and the Yin court reported the six calamities; seeing disaster, rulers grew fearful and restored harmony to the age.
units.literal: An edict stated: "Of old, Tang Yao questioned the Four Peaks, and the Yin dynasty reported the six portents; seeing calamities, they were stirred to fear, and all brought about timely harmony.

units.zh: 朕撫運應圖，作民父母，弗敢怠荒，以求民瘼。
units.en: I have taken up the mandate and stand as father and mother to the people, never daring to slacken in seeking out their hardships.
units.literal: I have received the mandate and answered the chart, acting as parent to the people, not daring to be lax or negligent, seeking the people's afflictions.

units.zh: 而霖雨作沴，害麥傷苗，隤屋漂垣，洎于昏墊。
units.en: Yet unending rain has brought ruin: wheat spoiled, seedlings destroyed, roofs fallen and walls swept away, until the land lies drowned.
units.literal: Yet successive rains bring baleful influence, harming the wheat and injuring the seedlings, houses collapsing and walls washed away, reaching to waterlogged ground.

units.zh: 諒朕不德，蒼生何咎。
units.en: The fault is mine, not the people's.
units.literal: Knowing my lack of virtue, why should the common people bear guilt?

units.zh: 刑政所失，罔識厥由。
units.en: Where law and rule have gone wrong, I cannot see the reason.
units.literal: Where governance and punishments have failed, I know not the cause.

units.zh: 公卿大夫士爰及牧守黎庶等，今宜各上封事，讜言極諫，罔有所諱。
units.en: Dukes, ministers, officials, governors, and commoners alike should now submit sealed memorials—speak frankly, remonstrate fully, and hide nothing.
units.literal: Dukes, grandees, ministers, and scholar-officials, extending to provincial governors and the common folk—today each should submit sealed memorials with candid words and utmost remonstrance, hiding nothing.

units.zh: 朕將覽察，以答天譴。
units.en: I will read them and answer Heaven's rebuke.
units.literal: I shall examine them and answer Heaven's reproof.

units.zh: 其遭水者，有司可時巡檢，條列以聞。」
units.en: For those harmed by the floods, officials should inspect promptly and report each case."
units.literal: Those who have suffered from the waters—the relevant offices may inspect in a timely manner and set forth the cases in reports."

units.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「潁川從我，是曰元勳；
units.en: On gengzi day an edict read: "Yingchuan stood with me—that was the first of founding merits;
units.literal: On day gengzi, an edict stated: "Yingchuan followed me—that is called a founding merit;

units.zh: 無忘父城，實起王業。
units.en: Do not forget Fucheng—that is where the royal enterprise began.
units.literal: Do not forget Fucheng—there the kingly enterprise truly began.

units.zh: 文考屬天地草昧，造化權輿，拯彼橫流，匡茲頹運。
units.en: My late father, in the chaos when Heaven and Earth were still unformed, saved the realm from the flood and turned back a failing age.
units.literal: My late father, amid the darkness between Heaven and Earth when creation was still in its first stirrings, rescued the torrent and righted the failing fortune.

units.zh: 賴英賢盡力，文武同心，翼贊大功，克隆帝業。
units.en: Worthy men gave all their strength, civil and military leaders stood as one, and together they raised the great work and founded the imperial house.
units.literal: Relying on worthy heroes giving their full strength and civil and military men of one mind, they winged and supported the great achievement and jointly established the imperial enterprise.

units.zh: 而被堅執銳，櫛風沐雨，永言疇昔，良用憮然。
units.en: Those who wore armor and bore arms, who endured wind and rain—to speak of them even now moves me deeply.
units.literal: Yet those who wore armor and wielded sharp weapons, wind-combed and rain-washed—in speaking always of days past, I am deeply moved.

units.zh: 至若功成名遂，建國剖符，予惟休也。
units.en: As for merit fulfilled, states founded, and fiefs granted—that was their reward and my comfort.
units.literal: As for achieving merit and completing the task, founding states and carving tallies—in that I find only repose.

units.zh: 其有致死王事，妻子無歸者，朕甚傷之。
units.en: Those who died in the king's service, leaving wives and children with nowhere to go—I grieve for them deeply.
units.literal: Those who gave their lives in the king's service whose wives and children had nowhere to return—I grieve deeply for them.

units.zh: 凡是從先王向夏州，發夏州從來，見在及薨亡者，並量賜錢帛，稱朕意焉。」
units.en: All who marched with the late king to Xia Province, and all who came from Xia Province and are still living or have since died—each shall receive money and silk as I intend."
units.literal: All who followed the late king toward Xia Province, and all who set out from Xia Province and are now living or who have died—each shall be granted money and silk in measure, in accord with my wish."

units.zh: 是月，陳武帝薨，兄子蒨立，是謂文帝。
units.en: That month Chen Wudi died; his nephew Chen Qian succeeded him, known as Emperor Wen of Chen.
units.literal: That month, Chen Wudi died; his elder brother's son Qian succeeded him—this is known as Emperor Wen.

units.zh: 秋八月己亥，改天王稱皇帝，追尊文王為帝，大赦改元。
units.en: On jihai day in the eighth month of autumn he took the title Emperor instead of Heavenly King, posthumously raised Wen Wang to emperor, proclaimed a general amnesty, and changed the era name.
units.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, day jihai, he changed the title of Heavenly King to Emperor, posthumously honored Wen Wang as emperor, granted a general amnesty, and changed the era name.

units.zh: 壬子，以大將軍、安城公憲為益州總管。
units.en: On renzi day Grand General Yuwen Xian, Duke of Ancheng, was made governor-general of Yi Province.
units.literal: On day renzi, Grand General, Duke of Ancheng Yuwen Xian was made governor-general of Yi Province.

units.zh: 癸丑，增御正四人，位上大夫。
units.en: On guichou day four Imperial Rectifiers were appointed, each with the rank of Senior Grand Master.
units.literal: On day guichou, four Imperial Rectifiers were added, with rank of Senior Grand Master.

units.zh: 九月乙卯，以大將軍、天水公廣為梁州總管。
units.en: In the ninth month, on yimao day, Grand General Yuwen Guang, Duke of Tianshui, was made governor-general of Liang Province.
units.literal: In the ninth month, day yimao, Grand General, Duke of Tianshui Yuwen Guang was made governor-general of Liang Province.

units.zh: 辛未，進封輔城公邕為魯國公，安城公憲為齊國公，秦郡公直為衛國公，正平公招為趙國公。
units.en: On xinwei day Yuwen Yong, Duke of Fucheng, was promoted to Duke of Lu; Yuwen Xian of Ancheng to Duke of Qi; Yuwen Zhi of Qin commandery to Duke of Wei; and Yuwen Zhao of Zhengping to Duke of Zhao.
units.literal: On day xinwei, Duke of Fucheng Yuwen Yong was advanced to Duke of Lu State, Duke of Ancheng Yuwen Xian to Duke of Qi State, Duke of Qin Commandery Yuwen Zhi to Duke of Wei State, Duke of Zhengping Yuwen Zhao to Duke of Zhao State.

units.zh: 封皇弟儉為譙國公，純為陳國公，盛為越國公，達為代國公，通為冀國公，逌為滕國公。
units.en: The emperor's younger brothers were enfeoffed: Yuwen Jian as Duke of Qiao, Yuwen Chun as Duke of Chen, Yuwen Sheng as Duke of Yue, Yuwen Da as Duke of Dai, Yuwen Tong as Duke of Ji, and Yuwen You as Duke of Teng.
units.literal: The emperor's younger brothers—Jian was enfeoffed Duke of Qiao State, Chun Duke of Chen State, Sheng Duke of Yue State, Da Duke of Dai State, Tong Duke of Ji State, and You Duke of Teng State.

units.zh: 進封天水公廣為蔡國公，高陽公達奚武為鄭國公，武陽公豆盧甯為楚國公，博陵公賀蘭祥為涼國公，甯蜀公尉遲迥為蜀國公，化政公宇文貴為許國公，陳留公楊忠為
units.en: Yuwen Guang of Tianshui was promoted to Duke of Cai; Daxi Wu of Gaoyang to Duke of Zheng; Doulu Ning of Wuyang to Duke of Chu; Helan Xiang of Boling to Duke of Liang; Yuchi Jiong of Ningshu to Duke of Shu; Yuwen Gui of Huazheng to Duke of Xu; and Chenliu Duke Yang Zhong as
units.literal: Yuwen Guang, Duke of Tianshui, was advanced to Duke of Cai State; Daxi Wu, Duke of Gaoyang, to Duke of Zheng State; Doulu Ning, Duke of Wuyang, to Duke of Chu State; Helan Xiang, Duke of Boling, to Duke of Liang State; Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Ningshu, to Duke of Shu State; Yuwen Gui, Duke of Huazheng, to Duke of Xu State; Chenliu Duke Yang Zhong as

units.en: (Sui)
units.literal: (Sui)

units.zh: 隨國公，昌平公尉遲綱為吳國公，武威公王雄為庸國公。
units.en: Duke of Sui State; Yuchi Gang of Changping as Duke of Wu, and Wang Xiong of Wuwei as Duke of Yong.
units.literal: Duke of Sui State; Yuchi Gang of Changping as Duke of Wu, and Wang Xiong of Wuwei as Duke of Yong.

units.zh: 邑各萬戶。
units.en: Each fief held ten thousand households.
units.literal: Each fief was ten thousand households.

units.zh: 冬十月甲午，以柱國、吳國公尉遲綱為涇州總管。
units.en: In winter, on jiawu in the tenth month, Pillar-of-State Yuchi Gang, Duke of Wu, was made governor-general of Jing Province.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on jiawu day Pillar-of-State Yuchi Gang, Duke of Wu, was made governor-general of Jing Province.

units.zh: 是月，齊文宣帝薨，子殷嗣立。
units.en: That month Emperor Wenxuan of Qi died, and his son Yin succeeded to the throne.
units.literal: That month Emperor Wenxuan of Qi died, and his son Yin succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 以柱國、蜀國公尉遲迥為秦州總管。
units.en: Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, was made governor-general of Qin Province.
units.literal: Pillar-of-State Yuchi Jiong, Duke of Shu, was made governor-general of Qin Province.

units.zh: 二年春正月癸丑朔，大會羣臣於紫極殿，始用百戲焉。
units.en: In spring of the second year, on the new moon of the first month, the court gathered all ministers in the Ziji Hall and for the first time staged the hundred entertainments.
units.literal: In the second year, spring, first month, day guichou (new moon), a great assembly of the multitudinous ministers was held in the Ziji Hall; the hundred entertainments were used for the first time.

units.zh: 三月辛酉，重陽閣成，會羣公列將卿大夫及突厥使者于芳林園，賜錢帛各有差。
units.en: In the third month, on xinyou day, the Chongyang Pavilion was finished; dukes, commanders, ministers, and Türk envoys were entertained at Fanglin Garden, and money and silk were granted in due measure.
units.literal: In the third month, day xinyou, the Chongyang Pavilion was completed; the assembled dukes, ranked generals, ministers, and grandees together with Türk envoys were received at Fanglin Garden, and money and silk were bestowed in graded amounts.

units.zh: 夏四月，帝因食遇毒。
units.en: In the fourth month of summer the emperor was poisoned at a meal.
units.literal: In the fourth month of summer, the emperor was poisoned through food.

units.zh: 庚子，大漸。
units.en: On gengzi day he fell gravely ill.
units.literal: On day gengzi, he sank critically ill.

units.zh: 詔曰：
units.en: He issued a death edict:
units.literal: An edict stated:

units.zh: 人生天地之間，稟五常之氣，天地有窮已，五常有推移，人安得長在。
units.en: Human life draws breath from the five constants between Heaven and Earth; Heaven and Earth themselves pass away, and the five constants change—how then can any man endure forever?
units.literal: Between Heaven and Earth, human life receives the breath of the five constants; Heaven and Earth have their end, the five constants shift and change—how can man long remain?

units.zh: 是以生而有死者，物理之必然。
units.en: That the living must die is the way of nature.
units.literal: Thus that there is death for those born is the necessary way of things.

units.zh: 處必然之理，修短之間，何足多恨。
units.en: Once one accepts that law, what matter whether life is long or short?
units.literal: Facing the way of necessity, between long and short life—what is there greatly to regret?

units.zh: 朕雖不德，性好典墳，披覽聖賢餘論，未嘗不以此自曉。
units.en: I am not a virtuous man, but I have always loved the classics; reading the words left by sages, I have tried to take their lesson to heart.
units.literal: Though I lack virtue, by nature I love the classic texts; perusing the leftover teachings of sages and worthies, never have I failed to use this to enlighten myself.

units.zh: 今乃命也，夫復何言。
units.en: Now my hour has come, and there is nothing more to say.
units.literal: Now it is fate—what more is there to say?

units.zh: 諸公及在朝卿大夫士，軍中大小督將、軍人等，並立勳效，積有年載，輔翼太祖，成我周家。
units.en: You dukes, ministers, and officials at court, and every commander and soldier in the armies—you have served with merit for years, supporting the Grand Progenitor and building our Zhou house.
units.literal: You dukes, ministers, and officials at court, and every commander and soldier in the armies—you have served with merit for years, supporting the Grand Progenitor and building our Zhou house.

units.zh: 今朕纘承大業，處萬乘之上，此乃上不負太祖，下不負朕躬，朕得啟手啟足，從先帝於地下，實無恨於心矣。
units.en: I have inherited the great enterprise and held the throne; in that I have not failed the Grand Progenitor above nor my own duty below. I may die whole of limb and join the former emperors below with no regret.
units.literal: Now I have continued the great enterprise and stand above the ten thousand chariots—thus above I have not failed the Grand Progenitor, below I have not failed my person; I may close my hands and feet and follow the Former Emperor beneath the earth, truly without regret in my heart.

units.zh: 所可恨者，朕享大位，可謂四年矣，不能使政化循理，黎庶豐足，九州未一，二方猶梗，顧此懷恨，目用不瞑。
units.en: What I regret is that in nearly four years on the throne I could not bring good order to government, make the people secure, or reunite the realm while two regions still hold out. That grief will not let me close my eyes in peace.
units.literal: What I regret is that, enjoying the great throne for what may be called four years, I could not make government and teaching run in order, the common people rich and sufficient, the Nine Regions not yet one, two regions still blocked—and considering this I harbor regret, my eyes at daily's close will not close.

units.zh: 唯冀仁兄冢宰，洎朕先正、先父、公卿大臣等，協和為心，勉力相勸，勿忘太祖遺志，提挈後人，朕雖沒九泉，形體不朽。
units.en: I ask my elder brother the Chief Minister, together with the worthies who served before, my late father's ministers, and you all, to stand as one, keep one another to the task, and honor the Grand Progenitor's last wish by guiding those who come after. Though I go down to the grave, my purpose need not die with me.
units.literal: I only hope my benevolent elder brother the Chief Minister, together with my former worthies, my late father, dukes and grand ministers and the rest, will join hearts in harmony and strive to encourage one another, not forgetting the Grand Progenitor's dying wish, to guide those who come after—though I sink into the nine springs, my form will not perish.

units.zh: 今大位虛曠，社稷無主。
units.en: The throne is empty and the altars of state have no ruler.
units.literal: Now the great throne stands vacant and the altars of state have no master.

units.zh: 朕兒幼稚，未堪當國。
units.en: My son is still a child and cannot yet rule.
units.literal: My son is young and tender and cannot yet bear the realm.

units.zh: 魯國公邕，朕之介弟，寬仁大度，海內共聞，能弘我周家，必此子也。
units.en: Yuwen Yong, Duke of Lu, is my younger brother—generous, open, and famed throughout the realm. He can carry our Zhou house forward, and he must be the one.
units.literal: Duke of Lu State Yu Gong is my younger brother by the same mother—generous, benevolent, and magnanimous, known throughout the seas; he can expand our Zhou house—it must be this man.

units.zh: 夫人貴有始終，公等事太祖，輔朕躬，可謂有始矣，若克念世道艱難，輔邕以主天下者，可謂有終矣。
units.en: A man's honor lies in finishing what he begins. You served the Grand Progenitor and supported me—that was the beginning. If you remember how hard these times are and help Yu Gong rule the realm, that will be the end.
units.literal: In human affairs, nobility lies in having a beginning and an end; you served the Grand Progenitor and supported my person—that may be called a beginning. If you keep in mind the world's bitter hardship and support Yu Gong in ruling all under Heaven—that may be called an end.

units.zh: 哀死事生，人臣大節，公等思念此言，令萬代稱歎。
units.en: To honor the dead and serve the living is a minister's highest duty. Keep these words in mind, and let later ages praise you for them.
units.literal: Grieving the dead and serving the living is the great integrity of a minister—think upon these words and let ten thousand generations sigh in admiration.

units.zh: 朕稟生儉素，非能力行菲薄，每寢大布之被，服大帛之衣，凡是器用，皆無雕刻。
units.en: I was raised in plain ways, not from any special strength of mine; I slept under coarse cloth and wore plain silk, and kept every vessel and tool undecorated.
units.literal: My upbringing was plain and simple—not that I could by strength practice austerity; every night I slept under coarse-cloth quilts and wore plain-silk robes; all vessels and implements had no carving whatsoever.

units.zh: 身終之日，豈容違棄此好。
units.en: At my death I cannot abandon that habit.
units.literal: On the day my life ends, how could I abandon this preference?

units.zh: 喪事所須，務從儉約，斂以時服，勿使有金玉之飾。
units.en: Let the funeral be spare: dress me in ordinary clothes and put no gold or jade on my body.
units.literal: What the funeral requires must follow frugality: enshroud in seasonal dress and do not let there be ornaments of gold or jade.

units.zh: 若以禮不可闕，皆令用瓦。
units.en: Where ritual cannot be omitted, use pottery only.
units.literal: If ritual cannot be omitted, let everything be of pottery.

units.zh: 小斂訖，七日哭。
units.en: After the initial laying-out, mourn for seven days.
units.literal: When the lesser enshrouding is complete, mourn for seven days.

units.zh: 文武百官各權辟衰麻，且以素服從事。
units.en: All civil and military officials shall wear mourning hemp for the time being and carry on affairs in plain dress.
units.literal: Civil and military officials of every rank shall provisionally don hemp mourning, and for the time being attend affairs in plain dress.

units.zh: 葬日，選擇不毛之地，因地勢為墳，勿封勿樹。
units.en: Bury me on barren ground, shaping the grave to the terrain—no mound raised, no trees planted.
units.literal: On the burial day, choose barren ground; according to the terrain form the mound—no sealing mound, no planted trees.

units.zh: 且厚葬傷生，聖人所誡，朕旣服膺聖人之教，安敢違之。
units.en: Lavish burial harms the living, and the sages warned against it. I have taken that teaching to heart and dare not break it.
units.literal: Moreover, lavish burial harms the living—the sages warned of this; since I have taken the sages' teaching to heart, how dare I disobey it?

units.zh: 凡百官司，勿異朕此意。
units.en: Every office must follow this intent.
units.literal: All the hundred offices—do not diverge from my meaning here.

units.zh: 四方州鎮使到，各令三日哭，哭訖，悉權辟凶服，還以素服從事，待大例除。
units.en: Envoys from the provinces and border posts shall mourn three days on arrival; when that ends, they too shall wear mourning briefly, then return to plain dress until the general rule for ending mourning.
units.literal: When envoys from the four directions and from provinces and garrisons arrive, each shall be ordered to mourn three days; when mourning ends, all shall provisionally don mourning garb, then return to plain dress for affairs, until the great precedent for removing mourning.

units.zh: 非有呼召，各按部自守，不得輒奔赴闕庭。
units.en: Unless called, each man is to stay at his post and not rush to court.
units.literal: Unless summoned, each shall remain at his post and guard it—none may rashly hurry to the court.

units.zh: 禮有通塞隨時之義，葬訖，內外悉除服從吉。
units.en: Rites may be tightened or relaxed as times require; once burial is done, mourning ends throughout the court and the realm.
units.literal: Rites have the meaning of opening or closing according to the time; once the burial is complete, within and without all shall remove mourning dress and follow auspicious custom.

units.zh: 三年之內，勿禁婚娶，飲食一令如平常也。
units.en: For three years do not forbid marriage, and let food and drink continue as in normal times.
units.literal: Within three years do not forbid marriage and taking wives; food and drink shall altogether be as in ordinary times.

units.zh: 時事殷猥，病困心亂，止能及此。
units.en: Affairs pressed hard upon me; sick and confused, I could only set down this much.
units.literal: Affairs of the time were pressing and numerous; sick and troubled in mind, I could only reach this far.

units.zh: 如其事有不盡，准此以類為斷。
units.en: If anything remains unsettled, decide like cases by what is written here.
units.literal: Should any matter remain incomplete, use this as the standard and decide similar cases thereby.

units.zh: 死而近思，古人有之。
units.en: The ancients spoke of reflecting hard upon death while still alive.
units.literal: To think near thoughts upon death—the ancients had this.

units.zh: 朕今忍死，書此懷抱。
units.en: I now force myself to live long enough to set these thoughts down.
units.literal: I now bear death and write down these thoughts in my bosom.

units.zh: 其詔即帝口授也。
units.en: The edict was dictated by the emperor himself.
units.literal: This edict was dictated from the emperor's own mouth.

units.zh: 辛丑，崩於延壽殿，時年二十七，諡曰明皇帝，廟稱世宗。
units.en: On xinchou day he died in the Yanshou Hall, aged twenty-seven; he was posthumously titled Emperor Ming and given the temple name Shizong.
units.literal: On day xinchou, he died in the Yanshou Hall, aged twenty-seven; his posthumous title was Emperor Ming, his temple name Shizong.

units.zh: 五月辛未，葬於昭陵。
units.en: In the fifth month, on xinwei day, he was buried at Zhaoling.
units.literal: In the fifth month, day xinwei, he was buried at Zhaoling.

units.zh: 帝寬明仁厚，敦睦九族，有君人之量。
units.en: He was open, clear, benevolent, and generous, kept the imperial clan in harmony, and had the bearing of a true ruler.
units.literal: The emperor was broad, clear, benevolent, and generous, harmonizing the nine kin groups, and possessed the measure of one who rules men.

units.zh: 幼而好學，博覽羣書，善屬文，詞彩溫麗。
units.en: From youth he loved learning, read widely, wrote well, and his prose ran warm and fine.
units.literal: From youth he loved learning, broadly reading the multitudinous books, skilled at literary composition, his phrasing warm and beautiful.

units.zh: 及即位，集公卿已下有文學者八十餘人於麟趾殿，刊校經史。
units.en: After his accession he brought more than eighty literate officials of civil and military rank to the Linzhi Hall to edit and collate the classics and histories.
units.literal: After he took the throne, he gathered more than eighty civil and military officials below the rank of grandee who had literary ability in the Linzhi Hall to edit and collate the classics and histories.

units.zh: 又捃采衆書，自羲、農以來，訖於魏末，敘為世譜，凡五百卷雲。
units.en: He also collected books from the age of Fuxi and Shennong down to the end of Wei and compiled them into a genealogical record of five hundred scrolls.
units.literal: He also gathered and collected the multitudinous books from Fuxi and Shennong down to the end of Wei, arranged them as a genealogical record of generations—five hundred scrolls in all, it is said.

units.zh: 所著文章十卷。
units.en: His own writings filled ten scrolls.
units.literal: Literary works he composed filled ten scrolls.

units.zh: 史臣曰：世宗寬仁遠度，叡哲博聞。
units.en: The historiographer writes: Shizong was generous and far-seeing, wise and widely learned.
units.literal: The historiographer states: Shizong was generous, far-sighted, wise, intelligent, and broadly informed.

units.zh: 處代邸之尊，實文昭之長。
units.en: While he held the honored place of heir at the princely lodge, he was in truth Wen's eldest son.
units.literal: Dwelling in the honored station of the prince's lodge, he was in truth the eldest son of Wen.

units.zh: 豹姿已變，龍德猶潛，而百辟傾心，萬方注意。
units.en: Though still young in years and not yet fully revealed in power, the hundred officials already turned to him and the realm already watched him.
units.literal: The leopard's form had already changed, yet the dragon's virtue still lay hidden—and still the hundred officials bent their hearts to him and the ten thousand directions fixed their gaze upon him.

units.zh: 及乎迎宣黜賀，入纂大宗，而禮貌功臣，敦睦九族，率由恭儉，崇尚文儒，亹亹焉其有君人之德者矣。
units.en: Once he was brought from Qizhou and proclaimed, with the former emperor deposed, he took up the great succession; he honored meritorious ministers, kept the clan at peace, lived in reverence and frugality, and cherished scholars—earnestly showing the virtue of a ruler.
units.literal: When it came to welcoming the proclamation and deposing He, entering to inherit the great lineage, then he treated meritorious ministers with courtesy, harmonized the nine kin groups, conducted himself in reverence and frugality, and honored scholars and Confucians—in earnest diligence he showed the virtue of one who rules men.

units.zh: 始則權臣專制，政出私門；
units.en: At first a powerful minister ruled alone and policy came from his house;
units.literal: At first the powerful minister held sole sway and government issued from private doors;

units.zh: 終乃鴆毒潛加，享年不永。
units.en: in the end poison was set in his food, and his life was cut short.
units.literal: At the end poison was secretly added, and his years were not long.

units.zh: 惜哉！
units.en: Alas!
units.literal: Alas!
